about: PyroSync archive for the Vercel demo: all five satellites, 2000-2026, slim columns, with the Indonesia boundary membership precomputed. Generated from the files in deploy/blob/db; the Vercel build uploads these parts to Vercel Blob and the function downloads them. Since 2026-11-15 the parts are downloaded from the public mirror in base_url (GitHub, Atatron/pyrosync-data, pinned to a commit), because the Hobby Blob store was blocked after exceeding its monthly transfer; if the mirror fails, the app falls back to the bundled slim database.
